text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break around noon. Later, I go to the gym or take a walk in the park to stay active. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a film to relax. I try to follow the same schedule every day, because consistency helps me feel calm, healthy, and productive.
